policy.objective: Archive and publish the maximum material permitted by exact source terms while keeping authority, completeness, privacy, safety and legal-status claims separate.
rules: Publish payloads and derivatives when an exact-item licence or applicable publisher-wide licence permits reuse and no item-specific exception applies.

When payload redistribution is unresolved, publish source metadata, public URLs, terms snapshots, digests, negative receipts and decision records; retain payload privately only when acquisition and retention are permitted.
When acquisition or retention is not permitted or is unclear, preserve discovery metadata only and do not fetch the payload.
Authority, completeness, freshness, privacy, safety and legal effect are independent of copyright permission.
Logos, emblems, photographs, third-party material and personal or restricted data are excluded unless separately licensed.

tiers.A: public payload, metadata, receipts and permitted derivatives
tiers.B: public metadata, terms, receipts and digests; payload after exact-item qualification
tiers.C: private payload only when retention is permitted; public metadata and non-reconstructive evidence
tiers.D: discovery record only; no payload acquisition
tiers.E: public metadata or safe aggregate only because privacy, safety or operational sensitivity overrides copyright permission

decisions.source: Stats NZ produced material and declared datasets
decisions.recommendation: Publicly archive exact-version payloads, metadata, receipts and derivatives with Stats NZ attribution, unless the item has a specific exception.
decisions.contingency: Downgrade an excepted item to B, C, D or E according to its exact terms and content.

decisions.source: Ministry for the Environment produced website material
decisions.recommendation: Publicly archive exact publication bytes, metadata and derivatives with Ministry attribution.
decisions.contingency: Exclude photographs, logos, design elements and identified third-party material; downgrade those components pending permission.

decisions.source: Ministry of Health items carrying an item-level CC BY notice
decisions.recommendation: Publicly archive the exact noticed item and derivatives with attribution.
decisions.contingency: Treat health information containing personal, confidential or third-party material as E or the exact narrower tier.

decisions.recommendation: Publicly archive bounded database extracts and permitted derivatives with OpenStreetMap contributor attribution and applicable ODbL share-alike notices.
decisions.contingency: Keep produced-work and derived-database treatment explicit; exclude mirror-only additions that lack compatible provenance.

decisions.recommendation: Publicly archive exact-version GIS payloads and derivatives after recording the item metadata and confirming no specific exception is stated.
decisions.contingency: If the layer carries different or third-party terms, use those terms and downgrade as needed.

decisions.licence: CC-BY-3.0-NZ where the GIS metadata applies
decisions.recommendation: Publicly archive exact GIS layers and derivatives when the layer or applicable GIS metadata identifies CC BY 3.0 NZ.
decisions.contingency: A catalogue record with no licence is B until its layer identity is bound to the applicable WCC GIS licence; identified third-party content remains excluded.

decisions.recommendation: Publish catalogue metadata, licence records, terms snapshots and receipts immediately; promote each payload to A when its exact item licence is captured.
decisions.contingency: Personal, owner-name, DVR or other specially licensed data remains C, D or E and must not inherit the common CC BY treatment.
non_claims: permission for personal or restricted data

decisions.source: Churton Park Village Supermarket catalogue record
decisions.licence: CC-BY-3.0-NZ on exact ArcGIS item aed53628016540388abfbe018da439b6
decisions.recommendation: Publicly archive the exact layer payload, metadata, licence receipt and permitted derivatives with Wellington City Council attribution.
decisions.contingency: If the item licence changes or a component is identified as third-party material, quarantine that component and retain public decision evidence where permitted.

decisions.source: NZ ambulance prototype and provider location candidates
decisions.licence: CC-BY-4.0 on exact ArcGIS prototype item e5b22c07d197417495c8012e945c41da; other provider candidates remain unlicensed
decisions.recommendation: Publicly archive the exact prototype payload and rights receipt with attribution and its mixed-source, non-authoritative disclaimer; keep other provider candidates at B-D until separately licensed.
decisions.contingency: Use E if a documented safety review identifies sensitive operational detail, or quarantine affected features if provenance or licensor authority is successfully challenged.

decisions.source: Hamilton and Marlborough council food-register archive packets
decisions.recommendation: Keep public metadata, receipts and bounded assertions; publish full payloads when the preserved terms receipt explicitly permits redistribution.
decisions.contingency: If the existing public archive already contains payloads without an explicit redistribution decision, quarantine payload publication while retaining non-reconstructive evidence.
